name: Vercel
description: Vercel REST API for deploying web apps, managing projects, domains, environment variables and teams.
auth_notes: Vercel Access Tokens sent in the Authorization: Bearer header; created in account settings. Team resources selected via teamId query parameter.
gate_detail: Developers create Access Tokens in account settings; no plan requirement is stated. Read-only or scoped tokens are reportedly unavailable (community thread), so tokens are full-account. No sandbox stated.
api_scope: HTTP REST API under api.vercel.com covering deployments, domains, projects, environment variables, teams, webhooks, storage, sandboxes and many other categories; SDK also mentioned.
mcp_notes: Docs navigation lists a 'Vercel MCP' entry under Build with AI, but no source describes it or states a URL.
blocker_detail: No payment or approval gate stated; tokens lack read-only scoping, which users complain about on Pro.

evidence.quote: Vercel Access Tokens are required to authenticate and use the Vercel API. Include the token in the Authorization header: Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>
Create and manage Access Tokens in your account settings .
All endpoints live under the URL https://api.vercel.com and follow the REST architecture.
You can deploy new versions of web applications, manage custom domains, retrieve information about deployments, and manage secrets and environment variables for projects.
The lack of read-only permissions prevents us from using API tokens for these use cases.

issues: Plan requirements for creating Access Tokens are not stated (access-tokens page was truncated).
Vercel MCP is only a navigation label; its status and URL are not described.
Webhook support inferred from a Webhooks endpoint category in the API listing.
